column1: # Re-tests the two cells where -ub 4096 regressed at -r 1, plus their -fa 1 controls.
# -b is held equal to -ub, matching how both prior runs were measured.
# RESULT: the regression is real. Both -fa 0 cells lose ~8% going 2048 -> 4096,
# at standard deviations under 0.2 — the 35B gap is ~50 sigma. Both -fa 1 cells
# are flat or positive. Every -r 3 value reproduces its -r 1 counterpart from
# 2026-09-08/09 to within 0.2%, so the single-repeat sweep was sound.
#   model  fa  ctx    ub2048           ub4096           delta
# The 35B/ub2048 pair was measured before a hard machine crash (CPU undervolt
# fault, no amdgpu message in dmesg); the rest was measured after the reboot.
